text:
Anya K: Hey team — finished the basic onboarding but when I open the Redwood Console (staging) I get a 403. Anyone know who can grant 'console-admin' for new hires? I'm trying to toggle a feature flag for my first-week task.
Matt R: @Anya K welcome! Staging console access is via Okta group. Please file an infra-access request and tag your manager. We usually grant a temporary admin role for 7 days while you ramp. Link: https://internal.redwood/infra-access
Anya K: Thanks — filed INC-4821 and tagged @Jamie C. My email is anya.k@redwood.dev
Onboard Bot: Quick note — to accelerate, include the Okta username and attach your manager approval screenshot. Docs: https://go/redwood-onboard/console-access
Jamie C: I'll approve once I see the ticket. One thing: feature flag (FF) toggles are a separate entitlement 'ff-operator' — request that in the same ticket or it'll be blocked by security.
Leo W: I can add temporary staging admin manually if needed. @Matt R can you confirm we can do staging-only? I need the Okta ID or email.
Matt R: Staging-only yep. Prod requires manager + security sign-off and a short access review with @SRE Team. If you need prod later we'll route it.
SRE Team: For validation after access is set, try: 1) open console https://console.staging.redwood 2) Click Admin -> Feature Flags 3) Run small smoke: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/health``` — let us know the result.
Leo W: Done — granted temporary 'console-admin:staging' to anya.k@redwood.dev for 7 days. Please confirm you can see Admin -> Feature Flags.
Anya K: I can see it now! Able to toggle a test flag in staging. Huge thanks everyone :party_parrot:
Matt R: Great. Pro tip: don't use prod flags to test. If you need a demo env with prod-like data we can spin a read-only clone. Ping infra and we'll arrange.
Anya K: Will do. Closing INC-4821 once I finish the tasks. Appreciate the fast help!
